title: Phrasal Verbs
note: One file for the whole topic: explore, rules, practice, play, gapfill and the game all read this, so a correction lands everywhere at once. `verbs` and `phrasalVerbs` are the reference data (which particles each verb takes, and what each combination means). `groups` holds the exercise groups the play and gapfill pages step through — it was called `verbs` in the old data file, which collided with the reference list of the same name, so it was renamed. `sets`, `practice` and `game` are the material for the rules page, the transformation tests and the matching game.
